published_result: The coherent type-1 FFL with an AND input function is a sign-sensitive delay element: it delays the response to signal ON but not to signal OFF.
reference: Mangan, Zaslaver & Alon 2003 J Mol Biol; Mangan & Alon 2003 PNAS
quantitative_criterion: rel_T_ON > 1.05 and rel_T_OFF < 1.05 (medians, relative to the matched cascade)

published_result: The coherent type-1 FFL with a SUM (OR-like) input function prolongs expression after the signal is removed, i.e. it delays the OFF step rather than the ON step.
reference: Kalir, Mangan & Alon 2005 Mol Syst Biol

published_result: The incoherent type-1 FFL speeds up the response to signal ON relative to simple regulation.
reference: Mangan, Itzkovitz, Zaslaver & Alon 2006 J Mol Biol
quantitative_criterion: rel_T_ON < 0.95 (median) and the matched-pair sign test p < 0.001
observed: rel_T_ON = 0.852; 65.2% of parameter sets accelerated; sign test p = 2.36e-22; signed-rank on the log ratio p = 1.79e-11; (signed-rank on RAW half-times p = 0.232, dominated by a minority of sets with large absolute slow-downs)

published_result: The incoherent type-1 FFL generates a pulse of the output: an overshoot followed by partial adaptation to a lower steady state.
quantitative_criterion: pct_pulse > 10% and median overshoot ratio > 1.1 among pulsing sets

published_result: Simple regulation (a cascade with no shortcut) shows neither a sign-sensitive delay nor a pulse; its response time is set by the removal rate alone.
reference: Alon 2006 An Introduction to Systems Biology
quantitative_criterion: cascade rel_T_ON = rel_T_OFF = 1 by construction and pct_pulse = 0

published_result: The incoherent type-1 FFL can provide fold-change detection, but only in a restricted parameter regime (strong, non-saturated repression and a linear-regime target promoter).
reference: Goentoro, Shoval, Kirschner & Alon 2009 Mol Cell
quantitative_criterion: 0 < pct_FCD < 25% for I1 topologies (present but regime-restricted, not generic)

published_result: The COHERENT type-1 FFL with an AND input function rejects a brief spurious input relative to a persistent one (persistence detection); the incoherent type-1 FFL does not - it is a pulse generator.
quantitative_criterion: median filter index of C1_TXN_AND above that of the matched cascade, and that of I1_MIR_AND at or below it
observed: C1_TXN_AND 0.938 vs cascade 0.851 (paired median difference +0.045, Wilcoxon p = 1.72e-156); the realisable coherent miRNA circuit C2_MIR_AND reaches 0.947; by contrast the incoherent I1_MIR_AND gives 0.812 (paired difference -0.022), i.e. it transmits MORE of a brief input than a plain cascade
